deployments_detail.use: AI customer-service chatbot / virtual assistant for clients and prospects, deployed on Facebook Messenger and the bmci.ma website, handling product/service and banking queries with escalation to a live-chat human agent; supports French, Moroccan Darija and Modern Standard Arabic. [Built with BNP Paribas group LAB/IRB innovation; hosted via a France-based service provider]
Partnership with Ecole Centrale Casablanca to upskill staff in AI/data-science and co-develop banking AI use cases; management states pragmatic AI integration strategy but no production system named

QlickEER: automated/rapid customer account opening engine built on OCR (optical character recognition), APIs and artificial intelligence, cutting request-processing times. Scope expanded in 2024 by the Acceleration Digitale tribe. [In-house (BMCI, BNP Paribas group) with OCR + AI stack]

Robotic Process Automation (RPA) program automating low-value manual tasks; concrete deployment includes an RPA robot automating processing of daily sickness-indemnity (IJM) payments in HR, as a continuous-improvement lever. [BMCI RPA program (BNP Paribas group)]

BMCI ON app: 100% remote customer onboarding for residents, Moroccans abroad and resident foreigners, using CNIE (national ID) document scan plus facial recognition to validate identity, delivering the RIB instantly after a video interview. [BMCI (facial recognition / biometric verification)]

Development and coding of risk/decision models used by BMCI: rating (notation), credit granting (octroi), decision trees, plus non-risk models for collections/recovery, fraud and marketing, including backtesting and independent model validation, under an intragroup analytics-services agreement. [BNP Paribas (model development / analytics services)]

SUN: automated, centralized screening (criblage) of the client-relationship database against financial-sanctions/watch lists for AML, anti-corruption and counter-terrorist-financing, using a detection algorithm that regularly and automatically screens relationships and generates alerts, delivered as SaaS. [BNP Paribas (SUN tool, SaaS)]

DiligenSE expert-system platform used to build rule-based Expert Systems for credit granting, collections/recovery and fraud (rule design, production simulation, generation and certification of expert systems), licensed, hosted and maintained for BMCI. [BNP Paribas Personal Finance (DiligenSE)]

Trade and communications surveillance (E-com/Voice) plus internal trading-fraud (Rogue Trading) monitoring for front-office operators, generating and clearing alerts across group tools, under the FRB/DMA Conduct remediation program. [BNP Arbitrage S.N.C. / BNP Paribas London Branch (group surveillance tools)]
deployments_detail.value: ~35,640 EUR/yr surveillance cost (18 employees x 1,980 EUR)

deployments_detail.use: Integration of AI into the IT/digital delivery roadmap, with first use cases in software development (coding) as part of building APIs and micro-service architecture around the core banking system. [BMCI IT (first coding use cases)]
